caption: GPT FX Lab / Dow Candidate-Basis-History Static Chart Viewer
description: App v0.9.1.22 / Simulation Rule v0.27対応。Expansion-Liteの上位時間足上限をH4へ固定し、DAY/WEEKをLite判断から除外。H4下降波中のdistinct Candidate Lowが2件以上ならShort Initial Entry/ReEntryを抑止する。T3 ExitではPositionだけをCloseし、Episodeと旧HSI/R3/R5を保持。旧R3内側復帰後の旧R3終値奪回＋M5 T3復帰＋BB外側Close＋BB幅拡大で同一Episodeへ最大1回ReEntryする。 v0.9.1.24ではFRB Studio共通Shellとのlayer契約を補正し、NativeShellでChart Viewer上部操作ボタンがShell背面へ隠れないようにした。

signal_policy.url_hsi_params_write_policy: do_not_emit; chart_comments.json is canonical for saved HSI annotations; legacy hsi params are still readable
signal_policy.day_upper_map_sync_marker: H1/H4/M5 hover/double click sync is kept as hover/sync guide when applicable; DAY UpperMap remains a broad D1 map.

high_low_range_style.purpose: Close線とBasis点の邪魔をしない範囲で、high/low判定根拠を見やすくする

bollinger_bands_style.purpose: 観測補助表示。Dow材料点抽出には使わない

url_chart_state_params.upperWarmupBars: 0 / 30 / 60 / 100 etc. Upper panel past context bars only.
url_chart_state_params.dayData: DAY UpperMap data path. Default is display_policy.day_upper_map_settings.default_data_path; URL value is a temporary override.
url_chart_state_params.dayConfirmBars: DAY UpperMap Dow material extraction confirm bars. Default is display_policy.day_upper_map_settings.confirm_bars_default; URL value is a temporary override.

url_chart_state_copy.purpose: 現在の観測状態をブックマーク・共有しやすくする

fixed_maximize_button.purpose: 横幅拡大が実質的な画面最大化操作になったため、人間フレンドリーなウィンドウ操作として右上固定にする

manual_hsi_lines.point_size_policy: JPY pairs default to 0.001, otherwise 0.0001 unless source.point_size is provided
manual_hsi_lines.interaction: right-click chart point to choose HSI anchor/comment; action menu auto-closes after operation; draw short horizontal lines at anchor +/- value*scale*point_size
manual_hsi_lines.purpose: 人間が置いた仮説起点から任意距離を可視化する観測補助。売買判定には使わない
manual_hsi_lines.y_axis_scale_policy: HSI target lines do not affect vertical price scale; chart body scale is based on actual price/MA/T3/BB/high-low data.

scale_step_buttons.purpose: ブラウザ標準numberスピナーが押しづらいため、倍率調整を人間フレンドリーにする

r23_mid_observation.label: R2.5
r23_mid_observation.definition: R2=89 と R3=144 の中間観測点。画面上は会話しやすいRange表記として R2.5 と表示する。
r23_mid_observation.purpose: R2/R3の間に、売買判断ではなく人間の単一点観測用の薄い補助線を置く。チャート上はpt数値ではなくR2.5のようなRange名だけを表示する。

confirm_bars_url_param_guard.description: confirmBars URLパラメータが未指定/空の場合はJSON初期値を使用する。未指定を3扱いしない。

window_navigation.purpose: 見たい相場だけを見る錯覚を避け、外れパターンを観測する

upper_timeframe_panel.sync_policy: shared vertical line by timestamp, not by x coordinate
upper_timeframe_panel.basis_points: Candidate / Active Basis / Retired Basis are recalculated on aggregated upper timeframe rows
upper_timeframe_panel.teacher_guard: Trend / Entry / Simulation are not judged in this version
upper_timeframe_panel.upper_warmup_policy: Only the upper timeframe panel is expanded to the past side. The M5 window is unchanged.
upper_timeframe_panel.day_source: M5_ENTRY layout: DAY may be aggregated internally from M5. EXPANSION_REVIEW layout: DAY UpperMap uses display_policy.day_upper_map_settings.default_data_path as external D1 DataSource.

wide_upper_panel_fix.reason: In two-pane mode, upper timeframe panel must remain visible when the modal is maximized.
wide_upper_panel_fix.policy: Use visible scroll area width for split panel drawing; do not multiply canvas width by widthMultiplier.
wide_upper_panel_fix.scroll_policy: Reset horizontal scroll to 0 after redraw because the split layout no longer needs virtual horizontal expansion.
wide_upper_panel_fix.teacher_guard: UI layout fix only; no trend/entry/simulation logic added.

url_launch_fix.reason: Previously copied chart URLs stored chart state but did not include data/view, and Core did not execute action query parameters.
url_launch_fix.policy: Plugin performs guarded URL launch after Studio data loading, and falls back to FX Lab default data for old URLs without data/view.
url_launch_fix.teacher_guard: URL replay fix only; no trend/entry/simulation logic added.

hsi_anchor_scale_label.label: 倍率: X
hsi_anchor_scale_label.purpose: HSI値だけでなく、何倍の倍率で評価したかをスクショと観測ログ上で残す
hsi_anchor_scale_label.note: HSI values are constants; scale is the observation scale applied to the current market/timeframe context.
hsi_anchor_scale_label.teacher_guard: UI label only; no trend/entry/simulation logic added.

hsi_anchor_label_direction.up_direction: Show HSI anchor label below the clicked anchor point.
hsi_anchor_label_direction.down_direction: Show HSI anchor label above the clicked anchor point.
hsi_anchor_label_direction.purpose: Keep the label from covering the HSI lines and future price area that the user is evaluating.
hsi_anchor_label_direction.teacher_guard: UI label position only; no trend/entry/simulation logic added.

chart_comment_sidecar.storage_policy: separate sidecar JSON; do not write comments into the price data JSON
chart_comment_sidecar.annotation_marker: human comment uses speech-bubble icon; simulation trace uses cyan diamond S badge
chart_comment_sidecar.popover: click marker to show tooltip/popover; edit inline in popover; near the top menu, the editor is placed below the marker to avoid overlap
chart_comment_sidecar.identity_policy: time/price/symbol/timeframe are primary context; x_index_hint is only a display hint
chart_comment_sidecar.save_policy: try overlay/api/data save endpoints; fallback to localStorage when file save API is unavailable
chart_comment_sidecar.teacher_guard: Human Comment is editable observation memo. Simulation Trace is read-only fixture/rule-execution explanation. No trend/entry/simulation engine is added in this phase.

chart_comment_sidecar_save_fix.fallback: localStorage is used only when the overlay sidecar save API fails
chart_comment_sidecar_save_fix.time_fix: Comment time uses rowTimeMs(row) before formatRowDateTime to avoid NaN labels.
chart_comment_sidecar_save_fix.teacher_guard: observation memo only; no trend/entry/simulation logic added.

saved_hsi_annotation_sidecar.storage: hsi_annotations array in chart comment sidecar JSON for the initial implementation
saved_hsi_annotation_sidecar.right_click_current_anchor: save current manual HSI as a saved HSI annotation
saved_hsi_annotation_sidecar.temporary_hsi_policy: normal click still replaces the current temporary HSI anchor
saved_hsi_annotation_sidecar.clear_policy: HSIクリア clears only the temporary HSI, not saved HSI annotations
saved_hsi_annotation_sidecar.visual_policy: temporary HSI uses strong red lines; saved HSI uses dashed amber lines with ◆ anchor marker; HSI labels show Range names only, not pt values
saved_hsi_annotation_sidecar.teacher_guard: saved HSI is a human visual hypothesis only; no trend/entry/simulation logic added.

upper_context_warmup_bars.direction: past only; do not extend future side for simulation context.
upper_context_warmup_bars.sync_policy: Shared vertical line remains timestamp-based; if timestamp is outside a panel range, skip drawing without error.
upper_context_warmup_bars.purpose: Reduce upper timeframe context shortage at the beginning of the M5 window and prepare future simulation warmup.
upper_context_warmup_bars.teacher_guard: Display/context warmup only; no trend/entry/simulation logic added.

saved_vertical_markers.interaction: right-click chart point/current sync vertical position to save; right-click saved vertical marker to delete

style.label: circled marker number such as ① / ② displayed on both panels; white-family label styling to distinguish from yellow cycle markers

saved_vertical_markers.purpose: 左右パネルの同一時刻観測点を保存するための観測補助。売買判定・トレンド判定・シミュレーションには使わない

saved_cycle_vertical_markers.interaction: right-click chart point and choose サイクル縦線追加; right-click cycle marker number label to delete

style.label: circled marker number such as ① / ② displayed one step lower than saved vertical marker labels on both panels

saved_cycle_vertical_markers.purpose: サイクル確認用の別系統縦線。通常の保存縦線とは混ぜず、売買判定・トレンド判定・シミュレーションには使わない

style.purpose: マウス位置/カレント時刻の左右同期縦線。サイクル縦線の黄色太線と区別するため白系の細い実線にする。

current_sync_vertical_line.teacher_guard: current observation guide only; no trend/entry/simulation logic added.

chart_comment_edit_draft.description: Comment edit form values are kept in state.commentEditDrafts while editing, so select changes such as exit are not lost by chart redraw/hover redraw before pressing 保存.
chart_comment_edit_draft.fixed_issue: exit option selected in comment type select could be lost and fallback to note before save.
chart_comment_edit_draft.teacher_guard: comment editor state fix only; no trend/entry/simulation logic added.

time_sync_center_dblclick.interaction: double-click any visible chart panel (M5/H1/H4/DAY) to center that timestamp in the M5 window and re-slice all visible context panels around that timestamp
time_sync_center_dblclick.sync_policy: timestamp-based; not x-coordinate-based. Upper panels are re-sliced around the selected timestamp only while sync center is active.
time_sync_center_dblclick.window_policy: M5 windowStart is recalculated so the selected M5 row is near the center of the current windowSize.
time_sync_center_dblclick.clear_policy: manual window navigation or window size change clears the sync center lock; hover continues to behave as a temporary guide.
time_sync_center_dblclick.teacher_guard: observation alignment only; no trend/entry/simulation logic added.
time_sync_center_dblclick.layout_guard: Existing M5/H1/H4 sync behavior is preserved; Expansion Review adds DAY/H4-main as additional panels using the same timestamp-based mechanism.

EXPANSION_REVIEW.right_top_panel: DAY / upper map from external D1 DataSource
EXPANSION_REVIEW.purpose: Expansion候補を、日足の格付け・H4本体・H1押し戻り確認で検討する。
EXPANSION_REVIEW.day_panel_policy: DAY UpperMapは広域D1地図として扱う。細かい縦線・サイクル縦線は出さず、D1スケールのActive basis high/lowのみ表示する。Confirm bars / marker policy / default data path は display_policy.day_upper_map_settings を正本とする。

M5_ENTRY.purpose: 既存のM5実行足観測UIを維持する。

chart_layout.sync_policy: All visible panels use timestamp-based hover/double-click sync. Layout changes do not alter syncWindowToTimeMs behavior.
chart_layout.teacher_guard: UI layout/context observation only; no trend/entry/simulation logic added.

display_policy.url_chart_state_policy: URL stores view/open state. Saved HSI/comments/cycle lines are canonical in chart_comments.json. Legacy HSI URL params remain readable but are not emitted by URL copy.

day_upper_map_settings.data_json_policy: D1 Data JSON is swappable market data. Do not store DAY UpperMap UI settings in D1 JSON.
day_upper_map_settings.purpose: Expansion候補が日足構造として妥当かを確認しやすくするため、DAY上にはD1スケールのActive high/lowとDAY Confirm bars単位の縦点線を表示する。設定値はデータではなくPluginの資産として管理する。
day_upper_map_settings.confirm_stride_line_policy: DAY UpperMap also shows vertical dotted lines every DAY Confirm bars. These are macro scale guide lines, not saved cycle/normal vertical lines.

week_context_settings.source_policy: aggregate WEEK bars from the external DAY UpperMap DataSource
week_context_settings.purpose: Expansion検討モードの右下WEEK窓で、大局の高値・安値構造を観測する。WEEKはDAYより広い履歴を優先表示し、保存縦線/サイクル縦線は出さない。confirm_bars_defaultを手動変更して週足材料点の粒度を調整する。

simulation_trace_sidecar.storage_policy: separate read-only Simulation Trace JSON; do not write trace events into chart_comments.json
simulation_trace_sidecar.annotation_marker: cyan diamond with S badge; visually distinct from editable Human Comment speech bubble
simulation_trace_sidecar.popover: 読み取り専用。日本語判断を最上部に表示し、理由コード・使用ルールIDを外部カタログの日本語内容と対応表で表示する。原因Event、上位足状態、変更前後、判断履歴も確認できる。
simulation_trace_sidecar.teacher_guard: Simulation Traceは観測・状態変化・判断・説明用Fixture実行を区分する。判断許可は売買実行ではなく、M5 TriggerとEntry/Close Engineは無効。

visible_range_run.detail_interaction: click marker to open existing Simulation Trace popover
visible_range_run.teacher_guard: 過去チャート検証用の仮想表示。リアル注文・資金管理・売買推奨ではない。

simulation_run_profile.snapshot_storage: simulation_trace_sidecar.run_snapshot: candle_sync + swing + dow + cycle + hsi_anchor + timeframe_states + upper_context_decision + trace_replay + run_result
simulation_run_profile.teacher_guard: NORMALとEXPANSION_LITEを独立Rule Laneとして同時評価する既定Profile。Expansion-LiteのH1 Entry Windowは方向別の最新H1候補安値/高値から14本以内で判定し、候補点を他Laneの起点へ流用しない。

multi_timeframe_candle_sync.timezone_recording: dataset timezone declaration + browser runtime timezone/offset
multi_timeframe_candle_sync.ui_reference: chart sync center M5 when present; otherwise current chart window last M5
multi_timeframe_candle_sync.teacher_guard: Confirmed candle synchronization only. No Dow/Cycle/HSI/Entry/Close decision.

dow_trend_evaluator.comparison_rule: last two confirmed structure highs + last two confirmed structure lows
dow_trend_evaluator.teacher_guard: TrendState observation only; H4/H1/M5 policy and Entry/Close decisions are later phases.

cycle_position_evaluator.origin_selection: latest confirmed usable Swing from per-timeframe profile
cycle_position_evaluator.chart_projection: latest cycle state event per timeframe
cycle_position_evaluator.teacher_guard: Cycle Position observation only; Entry/Add-on/Exit permissions are later phases.

hsi_anchor_registry_resolver.chart_projection: normal Dow-adopted anchor plus purpose-specific expansion references
hsi_anchor_registry_resolver.teacher_guard: 通常Entryは新しいM5 Dow確認Eventごとにprevious Swingを起点として採用し、1確認IDにつき最大1回だけR2初回到達でEntryする。同じ確認IDをReEntryへ再利用しない。Expansion Detectionだけは旧大起点を維持する。
hsi_anchor_registry_resolver.normal_entry_anchor_policy: latest M5 Dow confirmation event previous Swing; red/green swing alone does not replace anchor
hsi_anchor_registry_resolver.expansion_anchor_policy: retain original Dow detection anchor across non-directional state; keep separate latest pullback entry anchor
hsi_anchor_registry_resolver.same_direction_reconfirmation_policy: new confirmation event creates a new one-shot R2 entry opportunity

timeframe_state_builder.state_as_of: single M5 reference close shared by all timeframes
timeframe_state_builder.chart_projection: one current state summary per timeframe
timeframe_state_builder.teacher_guard: Observation aggregation only; no Entry/Hold/Close permission or trade execution.

upper_context_decision_engine.week_role: season and permission layer; never direct close
upper_context_decision_engine.profit_take_arm: H4 Late + BB Contracting + HSI Confluence
upper_context_decision_engine.exit_trigger: H1 monitoring; execution delegated to later M5 phase

ui: 観測/状態変化/判断/実行の件数
なぜこうなった？原因連鎖

m5_execution_position_lifecycle.section_caption: M5実行・建玉ライフサイクル
m5_execution_position_lifecycle.teacher_guard: 仮想売買の検証表示。リアル注文・資金管理・売買推奨ではない。

simulation_swing_point_detector.usable_basis_policy: only confirmed active basis points are eligible for later phases; pending candidates, candidate-only points, and retired points are not eligible
simulation_swing_point_detector.chart_projection: latest active high and low per timeframe are projected as Simulation Trace comments after Run Snapshot save
simulation_swing_point_detector.fixture_visibility_after_snapshot: hide fixture trace markers when real shared swing projection is saved
simulation_swing_point_detector.teacher_guard: Swing point observation only. Dow/Cycle/HSI/Entry/Close decisions remain disabled.

simulation_trace_popover_placement.purpose: Simulation Trace Popoverが画面上部メニューへはみ出さないよう、左右を優先し、入らない場合だけ上下へ配置する。

run_reference_context_menu.caption: この時点の状態を見る
run_reference_context_menu.top_run_button_policy: clear explicit context-menu reference and use sync center/window end
run_reference_context_menu.purpose: 一点観測はM5右クリック、Run全体設定は画面トップという2入口を分ける。

simulation_trace_replay_log.stable_internal_ids: English identifiers remain unchanged for machine references
simulation_trace_replay_log.teacher_guard: 履歴の再生は説明・検証用。M5売買を実行しない。

simulation_run_dialog.purpose: 表示範囲のEntry / CloseOK / CloseMissを先にチャートで眺め、必要な地点だけ一点診断で掘る。

simulation_reason_rule_catalog.management_policy: 理由コード・ルールIDと日本語内容をJSONテーブルで管理し、コード追加時はこのカタログへ日本語説明を追記する。
simulation_reason_rule_catalog.popover_policy: 日本語判断を最上部へ表示し、その下にコードと日本語内容の対応表を表示する。未登録コードは明示してコード自体を隠さない。

business_day_boundary_lines.boundary_definition: row.date changes; fallback to datetime local calendar date
business_day_boundary_lines.purpose: 営業日の切れ目をConfirm縦線より一段太く表示し、日単位のEntry頻度と相場の流れを見やすくする。

batch_simulation_runner.teacher_guard: Batch Caseは現在のチャート表示窓・同期位置・UpperMap非同期読込状態を継承しない。対象期間をCase専用分析窓へ固定し、Profile指定UpperMap DAYをCase単位で読込する。損益は1単位=1,000通貨の表示用試算。評価損益=実現+含み。手数料・スリッページ・税・資金管理・リアル注文は対象外。

entry_result_chart_navigation.teacher_guard: navigation and observation only; no entry or exit decision changes
